title: PersiaJS December 2025: Design Systems & Web Components
description: An evening of technical talks from the PersiaJS community on design systems, web components and engineering productivity. From building scalable frontend architectures to applying ancient wisdom to modern developer practice, the speakers covered both technical practice and wider approaches to engineering. The event was planned as a Twitch livestream with live discussion and Q&A.
highlights: Deep dives into design system implementation strategies
Hands-on insights into modern web components
Ancient Japanese philosophy applied to engineering productivity
Physiology and psychology for peak performance
Networking opportunities with the PersiaJS community
Recording planned for our YouTube channel

agenda.title: Welcome & Community Introduction
items: How to participate and ask questions

agenda.title: How to Implement Design Systems
agenda.speaker: Ehsan Gazar
agenda.abstract: Learn the fundamentals of creating and maintaining design systems that scale. The talk covers best practices, common pitfalls, and practical strategies for implementing design systems in your organisation. It explores tools, processes, and methodologies that help teams work more efficiently while maintaining design consistency.

agenda.title: Web Components
agenda.speaker: Ali Parvizi
agenda.abstract: Dive into the world of web components and discover how to build reusable, framework-agnostic UI elements. The session covers the Web Components API, Shadow DOM, Custom Elements, and how to create components that work across different frameworks and libraries. Perfect for developers looking to build future-proof component libraries.

agenda.title: The Warrior's Way: Ancient Japanese Philosophy for Modern Engineering Productivity
agenda.speaker: Ali Ahmadi
agenda.abstract: Discover how ancient Japanese mental models, from Zanshin (remaining mind) to Kaizen (continuous improvement), can transform your engineering practice and life quality. This talk explores the intersection of physiology, psychology, and sports science, showing how concepts like Mushin (no-mind), Fudoshin (immovable mind), and Shoshin (beginner's mind) can help engineers achieve peak performance, better focus, and sustainable productivity. Learn practical strategies for applying these timeless philosophies to modern software development.

agenda.title: Q&A Panel Session
items: Community insights and best practices sharing

speakers.name: Ehsan Gazar
speakers.title: Co-Founder, PersiaJS
speakers.bio: Ehsan is a passionate developer and community builder with extensive experience in frontend development and design systems. As a co-founder of PersiaJS, he's dedicated to empowering the Persian-speaking developer community through knowledge sharing and collaboration.

speakers.name: Ali Parvizi
speakers.title: Software Engineer
speakers.bio: Ali is an experienced software engineer specialising in modern web technologies and component architecture. With a strong focus on building scalable and maintainable applications, he brings practical insights from real-world projects.

speakers.name: Ali Ahmadi
speakers.title: Software Engineer
speakers.bio: Ali is a software engineer passionate about productivity, wellness, and personal development. He explores the intersection of ancient wisdom and modern science to help engineers achieve peak performance and better life quality through practical mental models and physiological practices.
